start: More → Help and feedback as the owner of an online gym that MettleUp has never opened

user_sees: 'MettleUp sees only your gym’s totals (how many members, check-ins and money in all), never a member’s name or number. MettleUp support can look at your records only when you let them, for one hour at most, and only to read. Every look is listed here.'
Button 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)'
'MettleUp has never opened your records.'
must_not: Access already open without the owner asking

user_sees: Sheet 'Let MettleUp support look?'

'MettleUp support can read your members, plans, receipts, check-ins, shop orders and staff list for the next hour, to help with what you asked. They cannot change anything. It closes by itself after an hour, and every look is listed here.'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Yes, for 1 hour'
must_not: Access opened by the first tap

user_sees: The sheet closes
The button now reads 'Close it now'
A new line in the list for this access
must_not: A window longer than one hour
The sheet closing as if opened when the server refused

start: Help and feedback in the cases where the card must not work

steps.action: Open Help and feedback as front desk staff
user_sees: No 'MettleUp access' card
must_not: Staff able to open the gym to MettleUp support

steps.action: Open it as the owner of a gym that is not online
user_sees: No card

steps.action: Open it where the server part is not switched on
user_sees: The card with 'MettleUp access is not switched on for your gym yet.' and no button
must_not: A button that looks as if it opened access

user_sees: The sheet closes; nothing opened; the list is unchanged

steps.action: Open the card when the list cannot be read
user_sees: A red line with the reason; the ask button cannot be pressed
must_not: 'MettleUp has never opened your records.' shown when the list was not read

start: MettleUp access card with a support window open

user_sees: The button goes back to 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)'
The line in the list shows the window as closed
must_not: Support still able to read after it was closed

steps.action: Open a new window and leave it for more than an hour, then open the card again
user_sees: The ask button again; the window listed as ended
must_not: A window still open after an hour

steps.action: After support has looked, read the list
user_sees: One line for each look and each other MettleUp action on the gym
must_not: A look by support that is not in the list
'MettleUp has never opened your records.' after a look

start: MettleUp access card; the promises on it

steps.action: Open a window and have MettleUp support open the gym
user_sees: Support reads only; the look appears in the list
must_not: Support able to change a member, a plan or a receipt
Support reading without an open window and without a line in the list

steps.action: Close the window; support tries again
user_sees: Nothing new for support to read; no new look in the list
must_not: Records read after the window closed
Member names or numbers visible to MettleUp outside a window
